beats.say: India now moves over one lakh crore rupees on UPI. Every single day.
October twenty twenty-six set a record: twenty-five point four seven billion UPI payments.
Worth thirty-one point five three lakh crore rupees, in a single month.
That's about eight hundred and twenty-two million payments a day. Roughly nine thousand five hundred, every second.
And for the first time ever, the daily average crossed one lakh crore rupees.
Here's the twist. NPCI plans a zero point four percent fee on some merchant payments above two thousand rupees.
It's been pushed to after Diwali, with no new date yet. Toh abhi ke liye, UPI free hi hai.
lines: No new date yet. For now, UPI stays free.

beats.say: So, should UPI stay free for merchants, or is a small fee fair? Tell me in the comments, and follow for a new breakdown every day.
